new_questions.question: If the previous treatment ended eight months before screening and RECIST progression was documented two months before screening, is the six-month timing requirement met? Which event or events must fall within six months?

For a course with repeated administrations, does progression after treatment has begun qualify while that course continues, or must progression follow the last actual administration or the documented end of the course?

If a patient has received another course since a qualifying progression, can PD associated with an earlier course meet item 18, or must the progression follow the course immediately preceding screening?

binding_gaps: Overall timepoint PD for this malignancy, with explicit RECIST 1.1 method and coverage of measurable and non-measurable disease.
Clinical effective date of the same RECIST PD event, available for the screening assessment.
An actual disease-directed treatment course for the index malignancy, including modality, course identity and the event dates needed to establish sequence and recency.
Source-supported relationship between the response, the treatment course, the same patient and the malignancy under review.
